description: Controlled benchmark of llama.cpp speculative decoding on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, one RTX 3090, commit 3737e4137. Repeated arm-runs, matched baselines, a Williams-square schedule, published raw logs. DFlash n2 and MTP n2 beat the baseline single-stream; an external 0.8B draft is far below it. The earlier no-net-speedup reading is retracted.
